_help: The in-game mod menu. key: INS, HOME, END, DEL, PAGE_UP, PAGE_DOWN or F1-F12 (not F11). pad: the controller button that opens it too (an Unreal key name such as Gamepad_Special_Left, the View button; "" for none). size: 0.6 to 2.2, 1 is the usual. cheats: whether its Cheats page starts with cheats on. Install again after a change.
